_comment: When an Age comes apart at the bottom (design 5.3), and how fast. The only manifestation that ends the
Age: fissures open at the world floor, widen, and put whatever falls in back in the overworld.
A verdict, so failing throughout. Its first step is the collapse and each further one how fast the tear
grows. `/age unstable <name> index <n>` is how it is reached for testing.
